title: Night Cream for Dehydrated Skin: Dry vs Dehydrated Explained
ex: Dry and dehydrated skin are not the same. Learn the difference, what to look for in a hydrating night cream and a simple routine for tight skin.
rt: Night Cream for Dehydrated Skin: Dry vs Dehydrated | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for dehydrated skin: dry vs dehydrated explained, common causes in India, ingredients that hold water and a simple routine for tight, dull skin.
quick: Dehydrated skin is low on water, not oil, so even oily skin can feel tight. Choose a night cream with hyaluronic acid, glycerin or aloe vera plus softening oils, apply it on slightly damp skin, use lukewarm water and pause harsh scrubs. Most people feel less tight within a few nights.
facts: Dry skin lacks oil; dehydrated skin lacks water
Any skin type, including oily, can be dehydrated
Apply cream on slightly damp skin
AC, hot showers and harsh face washes are common causes
